Ground Floor

Unit 1  $415 per week  Street parking only
Unit 2  $390 per week  Street parking only

First Floor

Unit 3  $435 per week  Street parking only
Unit 4  $390 per week  Street parking only

 Less than 100 metres to the nearest bus stop

With excellent access to the Gateway Motorway and M1, travelling north or south is quick and convenient, making this an ideal location for working professionals seeking affordable, private accommodation close to everyday amenities.

By registering, you'll receive instant notifications of any changes, updates or cancellations to your inspection. If you're looking for comfortable, self-contained accommodation that offers privacy, convenience and excellent value in a well-connected location, these apartments are well worth inspecting.
